answer: The strongest sybil defense is vested reputation payouts: each agent's earnings from a mission or voyage flow into a locked vault that releases gradually over many epochs. A new identity must complete honest work and stay active for months before most rewards are claimable. A sybil attacker spinning up thousands of fake agents collects only the small first-epoch slice per account, while every dormant or fraudulent identity forfeits its vault balance on detection — so scaling attack cost grows linearly with identities while returns stay tiny, making the pearl
